summary: One confirmed privacy blocker remains. Two warnings need product and target-level review before this build is ready for App Store Connect.

findings.title: Camera flow has no purpose string
findings.reason: The release flow requests access to a protected resource without a specific explanation of why the app needs it.
findings.fix: Add NSCameraUsageDescription in the Expo iOS configuration and explain that the camera scans parcel labels to add tracking numbers.
findings.verification: Build the release archive, inspect the merged Info.plist, then trigger the label scanner on a clean device.

findings.title: Widget privacy declaration needs target-level verification

evidence.excerpt: No PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy was found in the extension source folder.

findings.reason: Privacy manifests are target-sensitive. The app target manifest does not prove that the extension ships the required declaration.
findings.fix: Verify the extension target resources, then add the Required Reason API declaration at the widget source of truth if the archive does not contain it.
findings.verification: Export the archive and inspect the widget bundle for PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy and the declared UserDefaults reason.

findings.title: Primary empty states look unfinished
findings.reason: Two high-traffic screens use the same placeholder copy and provide no next action, which makes the product feel generic during first review.
findings.fix: Give each state a specific explanation and action, such as scanning the first parcel or adding a tracking number manually.
findings.verification: Launch with a new account and confirm each empty state explains the screen and leads to a working next step.

findings.title: Review notes can make the widget easier to find

evidence.excerpt: The app includes a home screen widget.

findings.reason: The note names the feature but does not tell a reviewer how to add it or what successful data looks like.
findings.fix: Add exact widget installation steps and the demo parcel that should appear.
findings.verification: Follow the notes from a clean simulator without using repository knowledge.

manual_checks.title: Verify the upload toolchain and supported OS
manual_checks.reason: The fictional sample has no candidate archive. Authored settings cannot establish linked SDK, Xcode, or each extension deployment target.
manual_checks.verification: Inspect each executable bundle and CI log against current upload requirements and the selected toolchain support table.

manual_checks.title: Verify scenes and adaptive layouts
manual_checks.reason: Screens and source cannot establish fold/unfold, Mirroring, per-scene state or SDK-linked lifecycle behavior.
manual_checks.verification: Verify launch, restoration, live resizing, keyboard and task continuity on the candidate, separating simulation from hardware evidence.

manual_checks.title: Inspect materials and accessibility
manual_checks.reason: iOS 27 readability, icon appearance and assistive task completion are unverified.
manual_checks.verification: Test Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, contrast, transparency and motion preferences through the core tracking flow.

manual_checks.title: Review localized store assets and claims
manual_checks.reason: Headers, search assets and Asset Library approval states were not supplied.
manual_checks.verification: Inspect approved localized previews and feature/device claims. Treat April 2027 Duo screenshots as a future requirement.

manual_checks.title: Run the iOS 27 compatibility matrix
manual_checks.reason: No iOS 27 runtime tests are included in this sample.
manual_checks.verification: Execute the candidate on the supported OS/device matrix and record actual results.

manual_checks.title: Core tracking path works on iPad
manual_checks.reason: The repository does not prove layout, rotation, keyboard, or split-view behavior in the submitted build.
manual_checks.verification: Complete add, edit, notification, and delete flows on a supported iPad in portrait, landscape, and split view.

manual_checks.title: App Privacy answers match production data flows
manual_checks.reason: Repository signals do not establish every analytics payload, retention period, or linked-data choice in App Store Connect.
manual_checks.verification: Trace production analytics and crash payloads, then compare them with the submitted privacy answers.

manual_checks.title: Subscription terms and restore path
manual_checks.reason: Static source cannot prove the storefront terms, localized price, and restored entitlement state shown by the release build.
manual_checks.verification: Use a sandbox account to purchase, cancel, reinstall, and restore on iPhone and iPad.

limitations: No App Store Connect metadata export was supplied.
Subscription and notification paths were not executed on a release build.
The sample contains fictional project evidence for demonstration only.
No candidate archive or signed capabilities were supplied.
iOS 27 runtime, Duo adaptation and new App Store asset checks were not executed.

dimensions.name: Product distinction
dimensions.evidence: The carrier exception timeline and shared parcel workflow are product-specific, but the first-run state hides them.

dimensions.name: Binary and asset provenance
dimensions.evidence: No sibling or prior rejected project was supplied for exact asset comparison.

dimensions.name: Visual identity and accessibility
dimensions.evidence: A consistent tracking-status system is present. Dynamic Type and VoiceOver still need device verification.

dimensions.name: Microcopy and interaction states
dimensions.evidence: Two primary empty states repeat placeholder copy and offer no route into the core workflow.

dimensions.name: Product-page specificity
dimensions.evidence: No screenshots, subtitle, promotional text, or description were included in the review scope.

reviewer_experience.label: First launch reaches the tracking list
reviewer_experience.detail: Supported by the supplied screen recording.

reviewer_experience.label: Camera permission appears after an explanation
reviewer_experience.detail: Retest after adding the purpose string.

reviewer_experience.label: Demo parcel shows a carrier exception
reviewer_experience.detail: A stable demo tracking number is still needed.

app_review_notes:
Demo account: <REVIEW_EMAIL> / <REVIEW_PASSWORD>

To test label scanning, open Track, tap Add Parcel, then choose Scan Label. The camera is requested only after the explanation screen.

To test the widget, add ParcelTrack from the Home Screen widget gallery. The demo account contains one parcel in an exception state.

fix_groups.title: Submission blockers
items: Add and verify the camera purpose string in the merged release Info.plist.

fix_groups.title: Target and reviewer-path checks
items: Verify the widget privacy manifest in the archive.
Run subscription, privacy-answer, and iPad checks.
Complete the widget navigation in App Review Notes.

fix_groups.title: Product craft
items: Replace generic empty states with screen-specific explanations and actions.

disclaimer: Fictional sample based on public guidance. Approval is not guaranteed. Not affiliated with Apple.

technologies.verification: Test attribution, private-content eligibility, index deletion after logout/account deletion, stale entities, and natural-language retrieval.

technologies.title: SwiftUI and document interfaces
technologies.verification: Test visible tab selection, state initialization, text gestures, image caching, async document operations, and scrolling under the actual linked SDK.

technologies.title: UIKit, scenes, and adaptive layout
technologies.verification: Verify scene lifecycle and resizing; replace layout assumptions based on the main screen, device idiom, or orientation when they fail in resizable scenes.

technologies.verification: Test each extension's signed configuration, App Intents, dynamic styling, privacy redaction, updates, deep links, and expired data.

technologies.title: Background Assets and background work

technologies.title: StoreKit and subscriptions

technologies.verification: Verify StoreKit 2, offers, refunds, restore, assigned/revoked seats, bundles/suites eligibility and rollout, and monthly commitment disclosures.

technologies.title: Music Understanding
technologies.verification: Verify audio provenance, permissions, model availability, analysis accuracy, cancellation, and licensed use of music.

technologies.title: Now Playing and media sharing
technologies.verification: Test playback state and controls on the Lock Screen, Control Center, Dynamic Island, and CarPlay; inspect each sharing extension separately.

technologies.title: Camera, photos, RAW, and video
technologies.verification: Test limited photo access, Center Stage orientation/cropping, capture startup, RAW export, and device-supported video processing.

technologies.title: Games, Metal, and spatial content
technologies.verification: Test touch and controller input, resizing, GPU memory/frame pacing, content rights, and availability of announced spatial APIs.

technologies.title: PencilKit and PaperKit
technologies.verification: Test handwriting language support, latency, editing/export, assistive input, and touch/keyboard alternatives.

technologies.title: HealthKit and HomeKit
technologies.verification: Test limited health-history authorization, unavailable samples, sensitive-data handling, accessory compatibility, and subscription/region conditions.

technologies.title: Trust Insights
technologies.verification: Verify the signed entitlement, connectivity failure behavior, privacy disclosures, and how results affect user access.

technologies.title: Identity, age assurance, and security
technologies.verification: Test credential recovery, age/parental-consent flows when applicable, protected actions, signed entitlements, and storefront-specific obligations.

technologies.title: Networking and accessories
technologies.verification: Check accessory/region availability, denied permissions, pairing, reconnect, and stricter TLS in affected managed-device services.

technologies.title: MetricKit and performance
technologies.verification: Validate crash/memory diagnostics, state reporting, hitch metrics, privacy-safe telemetry, and compatibility of renamed/removed APIs.

technologies.title: WebKit and embedded web content
technologies.verification: Test web permissions, auth redirects, content rules, downloads, resizing, and legitimate navigation under the candidate OS.

technologies.title: Tracking and ATT
technologies.verification: Trace tracking behavior and denial first; separately verify iOS 27.2 beta expanded-interface rules for affected EU countries and exact SDK API names before adopting them.

release_watchlist.title: iPhone Duo customer availability
release_watchlist.verification: Use available development tools; record physical-device evidence only when the device was actually tested.

release_watchlist.title: Duo screenshot submission requirement
release_watchlist.verification: Prepare device/orientation assets and recheck the enforcement date; this is not an October 2026 blocker.

release_watchlist.title: Xcode 27.1 simulator and extension limits
release_watchlist.verification: Distinguish simulator/Device Hub limitations from app failures and check the actual tool revision.

release_watchlist.title: iOS/iPadOS 27.2 tracking changes
release_watchlist.verification: Verify the expanded ATT interface, annual EU re-prompt and renamed APIs against the actual beta SDK and applicable region; do not impose a current worldwide requirement.

release_watchlist.title: Expanded subscription purchasing
release_watchlist.timing: Volume: October 22, 2026; Groups: winter; Bundles/Suites: later in 2026
release_watchlist.verification: Check eligibility and actual customer availability separately from access to configuration; test StoreKit 2 ownership, seats, refunds and restore.

release_watchlist.title: Preview and future framework surfaces
release_watchlist.timing: Verify the owning feature's release and region
release_watchlist.verification: Check AudioAccessoryKit, spatial APIs and other used preview capabilities individually. Resolved beta issues are not current app defects.
